description: Use Shannon entropy of observed field-width distributions to adaptively choose between fixed-width fast paths and variable-width slow paths for each column. Low-entropy columns get optimized fixed-offset extraction; high-entropy columns use general SIMD-scanned approach.
mathematical_formalization: H(W_j) = -sum p(w) log2 p(w). If H(W_j) < 0.5 bits, classify as fixed-width. Cost: C(j) = (1 - P_fixed) * C_scan + P_fixed * C_direct, C_direct << C_scan. Speedup: sum_j C_scan / C(j).
analogical_connections: Adaptive compression (LZ77): switching modes based on local entropy
JIT tiering (V8/HotSpot): promoting hot paths based on runtime profiles
Radar CFAR: adapting thresholds to local signal statistics
implementation_hypothesis: Profile first 1024 rows per column. Compute entropy. Low-H columns use direct offset extraction. Re-evaluate every M rows for regime changes.
experiment_seed: Test on fixed-width, mixed, and all-variable CSV. Measure correlation between column entropy and parsing speedup.
